evaluations.label: A
errors: Action item assigns Andrei to 'Follow up with absent team members (Maggie, Pierrette)'; in the transcript Susan volunteers to ask Maggie and Pierrette.
Action item 'Distribute documents of the new office configuration to all participants' is listed as a to-do, but Andre handed out the documents during the meeting.
Says 'Management recognizes this [lounge] as a priority'; no one said that. Susan questioned whether the lounge was needed and the purpose was left open.

Says splitting rooms is 'not feasible due to building and security regulations'; Andre said the answer is 'no for the moment' because of the work involved, and a colleague mentioned authorisation. He will check.

Says 'Staff can bring coffee into the reading room or lounge' and that 'cafeterias close by 5 PM'; the transcript has one cafeteria downstairs closing at five, plus vending machines. This is a minor distortion.
Timestamps are often wrong or imprecise (e.g. first section stamped 00:06, 'Schedule next meeting' at 32:46).
strengths: Most complete coverage: desk counts, 16 slots with a reading room, zero growth, visitor needs, project grouping rejected, smoking, Gisela options, other group, and the Tuesday 2pm follow-up.
Captures the four-desks-in-a-three-person-room question and the idea of placing Gisela with the school admin.
Has a dedicated action items section.
weaknesses: Misattributes the Maggie and Pierrette follow-up to Andrei and lists an already-done handout as an action.
Very long and repetitive; the same points (growth, building approvals, admin noise) appear in several sections, which makes the notes harder to use.
Frames some open discussion as settled (lounge priority).
Action owners are generic ('All participants', 'Meeting organizer').

evaluations.label: B
errors: Says there was 'strong support' for the lounge and that a majority leaned toward mixed use; Susan questioned the need and nobody reached a decision.
Lists 'a 2P room with a visitor slot' as an option for Gisela without noting that Martin and others called putting a senior visitor in the admin office unrealistic.
Next steps carry no owners, so Susan's commitment to ask Maggie and Pierrette is not attributed.
strengths: Concise, accurate and well organized into overview, preferences and constraints, lounge, and next steps.
Correct numbers: 15 people, about 18 positions, 16 with a two-person room used as the reading room, zero growth.
Correctly attributes positions to Susan and Martin, and records the part-time staff and the no-hot-desking point.
Next steps include the key items: room separation, four desks in a three-person room, Gisela with other admin, Maggie and Pierrette, and a Tuesday 2pm meeting.
weaknesses: Does not mention that Susan questioned the need for the lounge, and slightly overstates agreement on it.
Does not capture the discussion of whether to ask professors to share rooms in order to free a one-person room for Gisela beyond a brief line.

evaluations.label: C
errors: Uses anonymous 'Speaker 1/2/3/4' labels that do not match the transcript. 'Speaker 3 announced the relocation' and 'Speaker 3 will investigate' room partitioning is Andre, but nothing identifies him.
Action Items section says '(none)', although Andre agreed to investigate room separation and Susan agreed to ask Maggie and Pierrette.
Says 'Members were tasked with consulting colleagues, such as Maggie and Pierrette'; this was Susan's specific commitment.
Says the view is of 'the old town or mountains'; the transcript has the old town on one side and mountains on the other two.
Says 'Speaker 1 noted ... confidential discussions regarding budgets'; the content is roughly right but ties to nobody by name.
strengths: Lists the main open questions: partitioning rooms, four people in a three-person room, lounge purpose, and professors' preferences for individual offices.
Gives the next meeting as Tuesday 2:00 PM.
weaknesses: Anonymous speaker labels make it hard to know who said or owes what.
Empty action items despite clear commitments.
Omits Gisela as the key constraint beyond a passing mention, the 16 slots and zero growth, the idea of placing Gisela with the school admin, and project grouping being rejected.
Treats project grouping as undecided, when the group leaned against it.

evaluations.label: D
errors: The 'Preferences' section stamps the Tuesday meeting at 32:04, a minor timestamp slip.
Describes the 'lounge' as possibly reducing space and attributes the growth warning to Martin; this is correct, but it omits that Susan was the one who questioned the lounge.
strengths: Accurate attribution by name: Andrei, Susan, Martin.
Action items name owners correctly: Andrei on room separation and authorisation, Susan on Maggie and Pierrette.
Correctly states what was decided (nothing final) and what stays open (lounge purpose, Gisela's placement).
Captures the fixed room count versus open assignments, the 16 slots for 15 people, and the no-growth point.
weaknesses: Action items list only two items; it leaves out the four-desks-in-a-three-person-room check, asking about Gisela sharing with the school admin, and each person preparing preferences or a sketch.
The Tuesday 2pm follow-up appears only as a bullet, not as a next step.
Less detail on options for Gisela and on the debate about professors sharing with assistants.
Section headers and the leading summary are somewhat generic.

rationale: B is accurate, concise and covers nearly all the real next steps and numbers, though it has no owners. D is the most accurate on who does what but omits several next steps. A is the most thorough but misattributes the Maggie and Pierrette follow-up to Andrei, lists an already-done handout as an action, overstates agreement on the lounge, and is repetitive. C is weakest: anonymous speaker labels, misattributed items and an empty action items section.
